analysis: Secondary deployment-mixture sensitivity before scoring the v13 maps
conventions: Give half of the total weight to clean input and half to the five noisy profiles combined. Weight scenes, noise profiles and predeclared corruption draws equally inside each group.
Compare the candidate to the single best fixed rule available in every regime. Also report clean and noisy subgroup effects, individual distances and all scene effects.

A 50 percent clean frequency is an illustration, not an estimate of field frequency. Report the range of clean fractions from zero through one for which the candidate beats all common fixed rules. Mean score is linear in this fraction.

The preregistered clean/noisy screen and this deployment comparison answer different questions. Preserve both. The deployment comparison alone does not estimate the quality of noisy-input TCO or matched end-to-end latency.
